authors.name: Sarah Al-Rashid
authors.bio: Sarah leads TheWinner's editorial team with over 8 years of experience in consumer journalism. She's reviewed hundreds of products and believes every purchase decision deserves honest, research-backed guidance.

authors.name: Omar Hassan
authors.bio: Omar has been testing consumer electronics since before smartphones had app stores. He covers laptops, TVs, smart home devices, and gaming gear with a focus on real-world performance over spec-sheet bragging.

authors.name: Lina Mikhail
authors.bio: Lina tests kitchen appliances, home organization tools, and cleaning gadgets in her own home before recommending them. She's cooked over 500 test recipes and ruined exactly 12 air fryer baskets in the process.

authors.name: Youssef Nabil
authors.bio: Youssef covers everything from running shoes to camping tents. A weekend athlete and hobby collector, he's uniquely qualified to tell you which gear is worth the investment and which belongs in the clearance bin.

authors.name: Dina Karam
authors.bio: Dina is a former customer service manager who now writes about consumer protection, product authenticity, and smart comparison shopping. She reads the fine print so you don't have to.

authors.name: Tariq Sayed
authors.bio: Tariq tracks prices, hunts for deals, and tests budget-friendly alternatives against premium products. His philosophy: the best product isn't always the most expensive one — it's the one that gives you the most for your money.

authors.name: Peter Gods
authors.bio: Peter has spent two decades chasing the perfect sound — from soldering his first phono preamp as a teenager to running blind listening tests that have ended more than one friendship. He writes about turntables, speakers, and the strange, wonderful physics of analog audio, and still owns the warped Fleetwood Mac record that started it all.
